interface.description: Network interface to use for timing measurements.

priority.description: Priority (traffic class) for isochron packets, used in TSN schedules.

base_time.description: Base time for the TSN schedule (cycle time).

cycle_time.description: Cycle time for the TSN schedule.

shift_time.description: Shift time: offset of the isochron traffic class time slot from the base time.

advance_time.description: Advance time: how much in advance of the deadline to wake up.

report_file.description: Output file path for the timing report.

verb.description: Verb to run: daemon, send, rcv, orchestrate, or report.

log_level.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error.

dest_addr.description: Destination MAC address for test packets.
